target_customer: Hedge funds and institutional asset managers that use equity factor risk models
problem: Incumbent risk-model vendors' toolkits are slow and rigid (called 20-year-old by the founders); Bayesline fits custom equity factor risk models in seconds on GPUs, deployed in the client's cloud.
business_model: B2B enterprise software for asset managers (pricing not published; demo request only)

founders.name: Sebastian Janisch
founders.background_notes: Computer scientist by training per YC.

founders.name: Misha van Beek
prior_employers: BlackRock (Managing Director, head of portfolio risk research)
education: PhD Financial Mathematics, University of Amsterdam
founders.background_notes: Led team behind Aladdin risk models and economic scenario engine; met Janisch at BlackRock in 2016 per a profile.

competitors.name: MSCI Barra
competitors.what: Equity factor risk models with Custom Factor Attribution and cloud delivery via Snowflake

technical_complexity.rationale: Fitting factor risk models quickly on GPUs with customization needs quant research depth; founders came from BlackRock Aladdin risk and Bloomberg quant research.

defensibility.rationale: Technical speed and customization help, but vendors already offer customization; no data or network moat shown. Author judgement.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too recent to know; no incumbent response sourced.

market_need_then: Founders cite slow, rigid vendor toolkits; no spend or customer data sourced. MSCI's own brochure advertises custom factor attribution, indicating demand for customization.

branding.domain_note: bayesline.com (exact .com per YC website field); acquisition history not sourced.

brand_strength.rationale: No brand-specific sources; the tagline 'blazingly fast' is the only voice evidence.

outcome_analysis: Bayesline is an active two-to-three person YC S24 company led by former BlackRock Aladdin and Bloomberg quants selling faster, customizable equity factor risk models to asset managers. It is too early for an outcome: no verified funding, customers or revenue were found, and incumbents MSCI and SimCorp already sell customizable models.
